patronOf.en-US: The Bread of life for many
patronOf.pt-BR: O Pão da vida para muitos

prayerExcerpt.en-US: After this, he takes the paten or ciborium and approaches the communicants.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Em seguida, toma a patena ou o cibório, aproxima-se dos que vão comungar.

meta.basis: Ciboria are prepared on the credence table, 'if needed', with the bread for the people (GIRM 118c); the priest distributes Communion from 'the paten or ciborium' (the excerpt's rubric; GIRM 160) and purifies it after Communion (GIRM 163). As a sacred vessel it is of precious metal, gilded inside (GIRM 328; Redemptionis Sacramentum 117); hosts are reserved 'in a pyx or small vessel' (can. 939). The covered cup on a stem with a cross on its lid is the traditional form; the lid is set aside so the hosts show.
